rating.comments: The first message restates the task and is ignored. The only other student message, "Due to its higher density?", is a single guess with a stated cause but no justification of why density matters. It asks implicitly whether density is the right reason, which counts as a content question. It builds on the tutor's prompt with the student's own idea but does not extend or test earlier content. The student gives one short reply and no follow-through, so the conversation is too short to judge further.
